supporting_observations.claim: Two domain logon failures for kim.nguyen occurred at 13:45:25 and 13:46:49 UTC. Both were Logon Type 3 and reported source address 192.0.2.88; the second explicitly used NTLM.
A successful Logon Type 3 for kim.nguyen followed at 13:48:03 UTC from the same reported address, 192.0.2.88, using Kerberos.
The failures followed by a successful network logon from the same unmapped source are suspicious, but the available records do not establish whether the activity was unauthorized.
Kim.nguyen also had recorded Explorer activity on WS-KNGUYEN-01 shortly after the first failure; this does not establish who initiated the logons from 192.0.2.88.

known_telemetry_limitations: The authentication records identify 192.0.2.88 as the source but do not map it to a host or person.
The records do not show what resource the successful network logon accessed or what process initiated it.
The evidence contains two failures and one success, not a detailed authentication-attempt history.
claims_not_established: Whether 192.0.2.88 represents an authorized device or an unauthorized source.
Whether the successful logon was initiated by kim.nguyen or by another actor using the account.
Whether the failures were caused by mistyped credentials, a stale credential, or attempted credential guessing.
Whether any data or resources were accessed as a result of the successful logon.
additional_evidence_needed: Identify and validate the owner and location of 192.0.2.88, and determine whether it is an authorized source.
Review domain-controller and target-host logs for the session associated with the 13:48:03 successful logon, including accessed resources and session details.
Compare kim.nguyen's expected activity and authentication history around this time, and check for related authentication attempts from the same source.
unrelated_findings: At 14:18 UTC, Chrome on WS-KNGUYEN-01 accessed Google Drive pages and related Google-hosted resources. Google Drive is not among the approved services listed in the environment context; these records show access, not that files were uploaded or downloaded. This is separate from the alerted authentication activity. (T121-00021, T121-00022, T121-00023, T121-00027, T121-00028, T121-00029, T121-00030, T121-00031, T121-00032, T121-00033)
